text: 你分别抽空与每位队员相处，分享其他野外考察的经历。你的亲和力足以让大家再振作几天。一个雾蒙蒙的早晨，伯纳德和诺曼叫你到河边，展示一项惊人发现：一艘结实的大独木舟，只需稍作修理便能使用。附近看不到船主。现在你必须作出重要决定。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 459
text: You spend individual time with each party member, sharing experiences from other field trips. Your personal touch is enough to keep spirits up for a few more days. One foggy morning, Bernard and Norman call you down to the river to share an incredible find: a large, strong canoe in need of a few minor repairs. There is no sign of its owner. Now you must make an important decision.
